integrity: All finite stationary marginals and the scaling theorem have explicit analytic derivations. The numerical and exact-arithmetic checks are reproducible supporting evidence, not independent certification or an infinite proof. Novelty comparison is not exhaustive.
limitations: The theorem applies only to fixed finitely many weakly perturbed constant-rate slow sites, uniformly routed zero-range particles, the stationary canonical ensemble, and particle numbers in a square-root critical window. It does not analyze dynamics, growing defect counts, or random quenched disorder.
title: Critical chi and simplex laws for competing slow sites in a zero-range gas
